_intro_male_1.text: Welcome to Smart Dictation — a zero-cost ($0), one hundred percent open-source GitHub Pages web system started on October 22 (2 weeks ago) by Hansana and powered by autonomous AI agents on his own system. I built this project to test how far critical thinking and problem-solving skills can go, driven by a positive mindset to give something genuinely useful to our society in Sri Lanka for free — I will never seek money or profit from this work.

_intro_male_2.text: Although I did not take IT as an A/L subject, within just two months I stabilized my practical IT knowledge by exploring and harnessing several of the world's largest open-source databases and engineering resources. Building on those global open-source foundations, I have created my own open-source tools on GitHub — including my Remote Desktop PC (RDP) project, dedicated lab environment, and upcoming flagship IT project — to help advance the future of Sri Lanka's IT field.

_intro_male_3.text: This website is built with strict privacy protection at its core: no personal data is ever shared, no unnecessary data is collected, and every session review, feedback chat, and diagnostic report is one hundred percent end-to-end encrypted (AES-GCM) so your privacy is completely safe.

_intro_male_4.text: Engineered to run smoothly even on low mobile data, lecturers can update classroom word lists anytime through Lecturer Mode. Tap Start Dictation on the right to open the quick step-by-step guide and begin your dictation session from Word #1!
